video.title: [10-5-2025] FF3jPR Evoker solo SCC (part 3/3)
video.description:
Oh man.  I started at level 70 and assumed I would be fine to finish the endgame, because all the non-Two-Head-Dragon bosses would be free.  Unfortunately, Two-Headed Dragon also needs to die and managed a clean OHKO from full health in a trial run, so I needed to grind.
I returned at level 85 and it was still not enough, so I had to grind further to 90 to have a realistic chance.  I'm confident it was possible at 84 still, but this fight required getting 9 hits with Odin out of 16 uses, and never going last on any of my 22 healing turns.  With the way agility and turn order work, that is quite unlikely.  In the end, I spent close to 4 hours trying to find my win condition against THD, but I finally succeeded.
No elixirs were used in any other fight in this playthrough.
Evoker is an absolutely fantastic class, unironically, and is my favorite FF job.  It has very good damage, great elemental coverage and non-elemental options, and incredible support options.  Ifrit is only slightly less powerful than curaja but has like 5x as many charges, and evoker is the only source of multi-target reflect and haste in this game.  A single full-party reflect saves 4 turns against ahriman and echidna, which is a massive tempo advantage.  As a single isolated unit, it is quite difficult to clear, but still a lot of fun!
